offering_description.value: Provides secure transportation of cash and valuables, cash processing, ATM replenishment and maintenance, and outsourced cash management for banks, retailers, and other businesses. Delivers services through armored vehicles, secure vaults and processing centers, and digital retail cash-management technology.

primary_products.value: smart safes and cash-recycling devices; ATMs and related cash-handling equipment

primary_services.value: armored cash and valuables transport; cash processing and vaulting; ATM replenishment and maintenance; cash-management outsourcing; international valuables shipping

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, retailers, grocery and convenience stores, jewelers, mints, airlines, and other commercial businesses; B2G: central banks and government agencies

end_markets.value: banking; retail; financial services; jewelry and precious metals; government

revenue_model.value: service fees: secure transport, cash processing, ATM servicing and cash-management outsourcing; subscription: recurring fees for smart safe and cash-management technology solutions; product sales: equipment such as safes and cash-handling devices

value_chain_position.value: service provider: armored transport, cash processing and ATM services for banks and retailers using fleets and vaults; asset operator: owns and operates armored vehicles, vaults and cash processing centers

geography_served.value: global: Operations in more than 50 countries across North America, Latin America, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: cash-in-transit, cash management, ATM services, and secure international logistics for valuables

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams contracting directly with banks, retailers and government institutions; own locations: branches, vaults and cash processing centers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: armored vehicle, security licensing, cash handling, anti-money-laundering and transport rules across jurisdictions
